intro.title: fs, path & process
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple Node.js script that reads a file from your computer, processes its content, and logs information about the file path and system environment. You'll learn the core programming concepts of file system operations, path manipulation, and accessing runtime environment details using Node.js modules. The main technologies involved are the built-in Node.js modules: 'fs' for file reading, 'path' for handling file paths, and 'process' for interacting with the current Node.js process. This hands-on exercise will help you understand how to work with files and system information in a Node.js application, all while writing clean, beginner-friendly JavaScript code.
intro.usecase: The fs, path, and process modules are foundational for building server-side applications that interact with the file system and environment. For example, a content management system (CMS) dashboard uses fs to upload, read, and manage user files, path to construct correct file paths across different operating systems, and process to access environment variables like API keys or configuration settings. Developers rely on these modules for tasks like logging application events, processing uploaded data in forms, or dynamically serving assets based on server conditions, making them essential for robust backend development.
